change_summary: Shadow-tested a narrow zero-risk cut for the audited zero-collateral trend_instant_failure entry contexts without touching shared production logic.
hypothesis: Zeroing only the audited zero-winner-collateral trend_long instant-failure entry contexts will improve EV across the three fixed windows more stably than the rejected broad Technology reduced-risk cut.
notes: late_strong EV 1.5039->1.6042 and mid_weak EV 0.4773->0.5194 improved, while old_thin EV 0.1310->0.0948 regressed mildly rather than catastrophically. This is a materially better result than the rejected broad Technology reduced-risk cut, but not yet a clean promotion because the support still comes from two windows plus one regression. Next retry should promote only if a production-path patch reproduces the two strong windows and we can explain the old_thin collateral more narrowly.
